content.description:
Reproduce and confirm the Phase 2 IssueDetailPage gaps identified in the cto's review (comment mqdzwvhlyo on mqdzppxnai):

1. 'Back to issues' link missing in the main render branch — only present in the error/not-found branch (IssueDetailPage.tsx:60-61). Breadcrumbs don't substitute.
2. Raw issue ID never rendered in the DOM on the detail page.
3. Inline title edit unimplemented — the description has inline edit (editingDescription state) but title editing is not; test clicks the h1 expecting an input.

Run the phase2 e2e suite against the baseline (pre-Phase-4) to confirm these reproduce, and document exact failure output + file:line references. This is reproduction only — do NOT fix.

content.content:
Done. Reproduced and confirmed all 3 IssueDetailPage UX gaps described in the cto's review.

**Summary:** Ran the Phase 2 e2e suite → 51 passed, 4 failed. The 4 failures are deterministic (they reproduce in isolation too, so not flakiness) and map cleanly onto the 3 gaps:
1. Missing "Back to issues" link — 2 navigation tests fail cleanly.
2. Raw issue ID never rendered — confirmed via source review and the Playwright DOM snapshot.
3. Inline title edit unimplemented — confirmed via source review (no editingTitle state; title is a static h1).

**Baseline confirmed:** the relevant files (`IssueDetailPage.tsx`, `AppLayout.tsx`, the phase2 test) are unchanged since commit `1afdf15` (pre-Phase-4), so these are pre-existing gaps, not Phase 4 regressions — matching the cto's review conclusion.

**One extra finding for the implementer:** the issue title is currently duplicated in the DOM (once as the page `<h1>`, once as the last breadcrumb crumb), which causes Playwright strict-mode violations that mask gaps #2 and #3 in the test. The developer implementing `mqe054ells` must resolve this duplication (or scope the test selectors) in addition to the 3 gaps, otherwise the tests for gaps #2 and #3 stay red. Full technical details with file:line references are in the comment I added to `mqe054ells`.

Reproduction is complete; `mqe054ells` (the implementation) is now unblocked.
